errors.asset_budget_exceeded: The scene's assets exceed the asset library's budget.
errors.benchmark_interrupted: The benchmark's canvas, visibility or pause changed while it ran.
errors.benchmark_timeout: The benchmark ran past its time.
errors.browser_command_failed: The command failed in the browser; diagnostics hold the cause.
errors.build_mismatch: The page runs another build than the session's.
errors.build_result_too_large: The build's result exceeds its size limit.
errors.build_superseded: A newer build replaced this one.
errors.build_worker_unavailable: The build worker is not available.
errors.capture_failed: The capture could not be taken.
errors.capture_requires_pause: A capture needs the host paused.

errors.collision_incomplete_world: Not every collider entered the collision world.

errors.collision_numerical_failure: A narrow-phase test did not converge.
errors.collision_pair_budget: Sensors met more pairs than their budget.
errors.collision_result_budget: A query found more hits than its budget.
errors.command_busy: Another development command is running; retry.

errors.content_type: The request's content type is not JSON.
errors.duplicate_id: Two scene records share an ID.
errors.duplicate_request: A request with that ID already ran.
errors.entity_removed: The authored entity was removed since.

errors.hierarchy_depth: A hierarchy is deeper than its bound.

errors.inspector_limit: The development tools hold their most inspectors.
errors.inspector_too_large: An inspector's description or schema exceeds its bounds.
errors.invalid_animation: An animation or animation player is invalid.
errors.invalid_arguments: A command line's arguments are not ones the command takes.
errors.invalid_benchmark: A benchmark's mode, warmup or samples are out of bounds.
errors.invalid_browser_response: The browser answered with something not a reply.
errors.invalid_camera: A camera is not finite or its ranges are unusable.
errors.invalid_collider_transform: A collider's world transform is unusable for collision.
errors.invalid_command: The command is not one the bridge runs.
errors.invalid_grounded: Only roots stand on the ground.
errors.invalid_id: An ID is empty or has characters IDs may not.
errors.invalid_input: An input axis or turn is out of bounds.

errors.invalid_measurement: A benchmark measured no usable sample.

errors.invalid_world_transform: A world transform is not finite or degenerate.
